title: Introduce atomic lint adapter and rollbackable release quiesce
author: Emily Zhang
description:
Motivation: our premerge lint stage runs the monolithic linter across the whole monorepo which causes noisy failures and slow feedback for small changes. Release instrumentation currently uses a hard quiesce period that is difficult to rollback during incidents. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: (1) an Atomic Lint Adapter that shards lint invocation by package and by changed-file footprint, plus a lightweight action wrapper so teams can opt-in per-directory; (2) a Rollbackable Release Quiesce controller that implements a release annotation and a short-circuit API so on-call can cancel or shorten quiesce windows without rolling back the deploy.

Changeset summary: single continuous description below with checklist, commits summary, changed areas, reviews and CI notes. See related Linear ENG-1267 for rollout plan and SUP-412 for incident follow-up notes.

Checklist:
- [x] design doc attached and discussed with infra (link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1267/atomic-lint-design)
- [x] add action composite and publish ephemeral image tag for testing
- [x] add feature flags for adapter and quiesce controller (off by default)
- [x] unit + e2e for quiesce controller and adapter shim
- [x] docs: docs/ci/atomic-lint.md and docs/ci/release-quiesce.md
- [x] roll-forward plan and telemetry hooks added for 1-week canary

Commits (high-level):
- feat(ci): add atomic-lint composite action and per-package runner shim
- feat(release): add quiesce controller + short-circuit API + controller tests
- chore(ci): bump actions/setup-node + cache action pins for compatibility
- refactor(cache): introduce v2 build-cache protocol negotiation (backward compatible)
- docs: add operational runbook and rollout steps

Files changed (high level):
- .github/actions/atomic-lint/action.yml - composite action and entrypoint wrapper
- ci/lint/adapter/runner.go - logic to compute changed-file footprint and shard jobs
- ci/cache/protocol/v2.proto - cache protocol negotiation (keeps v1 server support)
- release/controller/quiesce_controller.go - controller + API ext
- docs/ci/atomic-lint.md - usage and opt-in guide
- docs/ci/release-quiesce.md - runbook and short-circuit playbook
- Dockerfile.ci-image, images/ci/BUILD.bazel - small image bump for setup
- tests/ci/atomic_lint_integration_test.go - new e2e harness

Testing and rollout:
- Local unit tests: go test ./ci/... (green)
- Integration: atomic-lint was exercised in a canary repo (redwood-examples) with flaky file detection disabled; two minor fixes pushed after initial run
- Quiesce controller tested end-to-end against staging controller; added a short-circuit endpoint and RBAC guard
- Canary window: enabled for team/platform/* routes for 72 hours; telemetry keyed under telemetry.ci.atomic_lint.* and telemetry.release.quiesce.*

Review conversation (thread summary):
- Ravi Kapoor (review): "Nice separation. A few questions on concurrency: will the atomic adapter ever hit the coordinator with >100 shards for a single PR? How do we limit executor fanout?" — Author reply: "Adapter groups by package and has a max_shards config default 12; added a coordinator-side rate limiter and a fallback to run monolithic lint if shard budget exceeded. See ci/lint/adapter/runner.go lines flagged." 
- Aisha Parker (request changes): "Cache protocol negotiation looks okay but make sure v2 falls back cleanly to v1 servers. Add an integration test that mocks v1 behavior." — Author reply: "Added v1 mock server in tests/ci/cache_mock_v1_test.go and included compat test in CI matrix."
- Leo Martinez (approval): "Approach is sensible and deployable. Suggest adding a small audit metric for quiesce short-circuits (who invoked)." — Author reply: "Added audit metric and associated tag in quiesce_controller.go; included in telemetry registration."
- Final /commit: after a small CI flake on the integration job we reran the job; fixed a test ordering race in atomic_lint_integration_test.go. Approvals: Ravi Kapoor approved 2024-11-04, Leo Martinez approved 2024-11-05.

CI status details: initial run had one failing integration (flaky test), rerun succeeded. Checks: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration-canary (pass after rerun), lint (pass), security-scan (pass). GitHub Actions matrix included linux/go1.20 and linux/go1.22 lanes.

Merge and post-merge actions: merged via squash on 2024-11-06 by Ravi Kapoor. Post-merge: created rollout Linear task ENG-1291 to stagger enabling and to add quota for shard limits. Feature gates default to off; rollout window captured in docs/ci/release-quiesce.md.

release_notes: Add atomic lint adapter (opt-in) to shard lint runs by changed-file footprint; add a rollbackable release quiesce controller with short-circuit API; backward-compatible v2 build-cache protocol negotiation; CI action pin bumps and docs. Feature gated off by default; rollout under ENG-1291.
notes: This PR touches CI tooling and release infra; operations should monitor telemetry.ci.atomic_lint.* and telemetry.release.quiesce.* during rollout. If on-call needs to abort quiesce, call POST /api/v1/quiesce/short-circuit with audit header.
